analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for the third consecutive session. RSI is hovering in the neutral zone after exiting oversold territory, and the MACD histogram shows no clear improvement, indicating a lack of directional momentum. The weekly ADX at 26.7 suggests an existing trend, but no clear buy/sell signals are present on the daily chart.
